artist.name: Frawley
artist.short_description: Frawley is an Afterglow discovery artist in the broader emotional-pop and songwriter catalogue.
artist.biography: Frawley is an American pop singer-songwriter who first attracted attention for her online covers as a teenager before building a catalogue of original recordings. Her early release 'Hard Boy' was followed by more emotionally candid songs such as 'No One Can Fix Me,' 'If I Don't Laugh, I'll Cry' and 'Crying My Eyes Out.' In interviews, she has discussed writing for other performers as well as her solo work and wanting listeners to feel understood rather than isolated by experiences of heartbreak. She described 'Crying My Eyes Out' as a change in approach: compared with earlier production-heavy songs, she wanted her writing and vocal performance to take the foreground. 'Figure You Out' offers a contrasting, more energetic pop direction. She has also co-written songs in the wider pop industry. For Afterglow she is a natural bridge between Ashley Kutcher, Sody and the more radio-facing side of emotional pop. Her songs are best presented with first-person sources where available; genre, mood and narrative labels for the other selections should be treated as editorial work pending listening or further documentation.
